snippet.title: Game Gear - Zoop © 1995 Viacom New Media - Gameplay
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Right here inside this little box is the excitement you crave, the challenge you need. Level after level of brain-burning action coming at you from all sides, faster and faster until your thumbs are numb, your eyes are aching and your mind is molten. And there's only ONE thing you know... "I can't stop playing this game!"
